start: Staff & sign-in, the top of the page says everything is sent

steps.action: In the card 'You' tap 'Sign out of this device'
user_sees: Sheet 'Sign out of this device?'
'Your gym stays online. To come back, sign in with your mobile number and a new code. An owner makes the code in Staff & sign-in.'
Buttons 'Cancel' and 'Sign out'

steps.action: Tap 'Sign out'
user_sees: 'Working…'
The welcome screen with 'You are signed out of this device.'
must_not: The gym still open with the back button
Members still readable on this device with no internet
Other devices of the same person signed out too

start: An owner of a gym with three branches, signed in on this device

steps.action: Tap 'Sign out of this device', then 'Sign out'
user_sees: The welcome screen with 'You are signed out of this device.'
must_not: Another branch still opening on this device without a sign-in

start: Staff & sign-in, three payments taken with no internet still wait to be sent

steps.action: Tap 'Sign out of this device'
user_sees: '3 saved on this device are still waiting to send. Wait for "All sent" at the top before you sign out.'
'Sign out' is greyed

steps.action: Tap 'Cancel', wait for 'All sent', open the sheet again
user_sees: The plain 'Your gym stays online…' words and a working 'Sign out'
must_not: The button still greyed after all is sent

start: An owner with a PIN signs out and comes back; one payment was refused by the server

steps.action: Tap 'Sign out of this device' while one saved payment could not be sent
user_sees: '1 saved on this device could not be sent (see the top of the page). If you sign out, it stays on this device until someone from this gym signs in here again.'
'Sign out' can be tapped
must_not: The refused payment deleted by signing out

steps.action: Tap 'Sign out'
user_sees: 'You are signed out of this device.'
must_not: The device still holding its key

steps.action: Sign in again on the same device with the mobile number and the own PIN
user_sees: The gym opens; the refused payment is still named at the top
must_not: A new code needed although the sheet said so and a PIN is set

start: The front desk computer is shared; the owner signs out before leaving

steps.action: Sign out, then turn the internet off and open the panel
user_sees: The welcome screen only
must_not: Members, payments or phone numbers from the saved copy of the gym

steps.action: Look at what this browser still keeps
user_sees: Only what was not sent yet, kept for the next sign-in of this gym
must_not: An older browser-only copy of the gym still lying in this browser with member names, with no word about it
